cells.quote: We found a moderate, positive, and statistically significant mean effect of 𝑔̅ = 0.11, 95% CI[0.035, 0.184] of collaborative instruction compared to single-taught controls, using the correlated-hierarchical effects (CHE-RVE) model.
cells.note: Pooled meta-analysis of 76 studies and 280 short-term effect sizes; included randomized, quasi-experimental, and observational treatment-control studies.

D.comparison: collaborative instruction involving assistants without teaching qualifications

cells.quote: From moderator analyses, we found that collaborative instruction yields effects of mostly the same size, whether the interventions involved trained teachers or assistants with no teaching qualifications.
cells.note: The study reports no exact subgroup effect sizes, significance test, or power information for this moderator comparison.
